summary.text: Bob Lewis is a Republican state representative who has represented District 123 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
An attorney by profession, he chairs the Corrections and Juvenile Justice Committee and serves on the House Judiciary Committee, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Bob Lewis was born in Garden City, Kansas, and graduated from Garden City High School in 1976.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Grinnell College in 1980 and a law degree from Stanford University in 1984, and his career experience includes working as an attorney.
Lewis has served on the board of the Garden City Family YMCA and as a Finney County Republican Precinct Committeeman.
Lewis took office in the Kansas House on January 9, 2023, succeeding John Wheeler Jr., and advanced from the Republican primary on August 4, 2026.

For 2025 and 2026 Ballotpedia lists his committee assignments as House Federal and State Affairs, House Judiciary, Rules and Journal, Corrections and Juvenile Justice (chair), Corrections and Juvenile Justice Oversight (chair), Special Claims Against the State, and State Building Construction.
